en: Sepia-toned postcard showing an illuminated arcade with arches and columns opening onto a courtyard at night. In the background are exhibition-style buildings and a tall tower. Handwritten-style Swedish text appears at the top and bottom identifying the Baltic Exhibition in Malmö in 1914 and indicating the view over the central garden. The card is labeled as an official postcard.
